ns2:course.label: Investments and Financial Markets
ns2:course.description: An introduction to financial models and their applications to investment and financial markets. Topics include derivative markets, derivatives pricing, interest rate models, dynamic hedging and other risk management techniques. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in ASRM 402 or STAT 410.
